evidenceNotes: All packaged screenshots are current PHASE-3-003 settings/fallback/production captures. Retained earlier regression tests still generate VFX evidence, but those images are not presented as new audio evidence.

A test-only analyser captures the actual final live bus without adding a second destination path. Context creation is counted and verified inside a real user gesture; no pre-launch autoplay context is created.
Damage fixtures enter the actual collision path. Five restarts retain one AudioContext and the same graph, four continuous sources, a six-voice temporary limit and six total GLB downloads.

Native OfflineAudioContext renders the same synthesis/routing implementation into real PCM. Tests check nonzero output, mute decay and six-voice maximum-volume peak headroom. Preview WAV files are generated PCM, not microphone recordings or subjective listening tests.
Missing and rejected AudioContext fixtures verify playable silent fallback. Mobile landscape settings scroll internally so touch targets stay at least 44 pixels high.
Production is a real route-42 run with working sound controls and no developer access/collider overlay. No runtime audio URLs are used.

Matched six-hazard Chrome/GPU/viewports use 60 warmup and 180 measured frames. Final runs also synchronize audio and report its CPU timing separately; RAF intervals include native audio work. No physical phone/GPU timer claims.
The missing-model test intentionally creates an HTTP 404 and verifies retry recovery. Other browser tests require clean console/network logs.
limitations: Subjective listening quality and device speaker/headphone balance require the manual AUDIO-DESIGN checklist; automated signal checks do not establish taste or comfort.
Physical phones, Safari/Firefox, sustained thermal/heap behavior and GPU/DSP profiling remain unverified.
Collision proxies approximate surfaces; rounded-box/sphere intersections can retain small conservative errors near seams, with bounded rotation padding below 0.007 world units at 120 Hz.
The approved forgiving ship sphere excludes decorative wings. Existing VFX and gameplay remain unchanged. Yandex SDK is outside PHASE-3-003.
The existing Vite chunk-size advisory remains unchanged; no build-system refactor or threshold adjustment.
